c74object.name: mc.syncSuite.compressor~
c74object.description: Detector (peak, or RMS with rms_time) on each channel, optionally through a high-pass (sc_hpf), linked within groups (link_detect: the loudest channel, or the mean power of the group), soft-knee static curve (Giannoulis, Massberg, Reiss 2012), range (most reduction allowed), smooth-branching attack / release on the gain in dB, lookahead delay, mix (parallel). Below the threshold, with mix 0 or with the whole group quiet, the output is the input, delayed by the lookahead, bit for bit. Latency: the lookahead. CPU: about 0.03% of a core per channel at 48 kHz. Built for speaker layouts. LINK GROUPS: every channel belongs to a group (groups attribute; default: all mains in one group, the LFE channels in another). Within a group, link 0..1 blends each channel's own control signal with the group's; at 1 every speaker of the group gets the same gain at every sample, so relative levels, and with them the spatial image, cannot move. EXACT REPORTING: the gain reduction shown and output is the gain actually multiplied into the audio (after linking, ballistics, lookahead and mix), excluding make-up / drive. IMAGE: the input and output energy vectors (Gerzon, from speaker_coords) are compared over 400 ms: the display and the image message give how many degrees the processing turned the image and how much it widened (negative) or narrowed it. DISPLAY: meters (input dim, output bright, gain reduction from the top, hold, link-group colour under each channel), history (the last 10 s of gain reduction per channel, deepest reduction on top), curve (static curve and every channel's operating point), image, statistics (max reduction, share of time reducing, latency). BYPASS keeps the latency and the meters (they show what would be done). Latency is output as latency <samples> <ms> whenever it changes. Nothing is emulated: feed-forward, log-domain gain computer, no saturation.

method.name: get
method.description: gr, gr_max, in_peak_max, out_peak_max (per channel, dB), image (shift deg, width change, azimuth in, azimuth out), stats (max reduction dB, % of time reducing, seconds, clips), latency (samples, ms).

method.name: signal
method.digest: Speaker feeds, channel i = speaker i

attribute.name: makeup
attribute.description: Not part of the gain reduction.

attribute.name: sc_hpf
attribute.description: 0 = off. 12 dB/oct Butterworth on the detector only.

attribute.name: speaker_coords
attribute.description: One per channel, deg, 0 = front, clockwise (as syncSuite.nodes). Empty = even ring of the non-LFE channels. Used for the image and the fold-down.

attribute.name: lfe
attribute.description: Not positioned; own group by default.

attribute.name: groups
attribute.description: Any integers, one per channel (a shorter list repeats its last value). Empty = mains / LFE.

attribute.name: link
attribute.description: 0 = independent channels, 1 = the same gain for the whole group (default).

attribute.name: bypass
attribute.description: Output = input (latency-aligned; multiband: the band sum); meters keep showing what would be done.

outlet.digest: Processed speaker feeds (same channels as the input)
